SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 260 AND 305
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 100;
